log.raw: {"understanding":{"purpose":"Provide a compact reference to CLI flags, their value types, defaults, and effects.","tasks":["Find a flag by name or alias and read across its row.","Compare types and defaults between flags.","Read each description to understand when and how to use a flag."],"relations":["Each row connects a flag or its aliases to one type, one default, and one description.","The host and port placeholder belongs to the inspector flag; the address and port in its default form one value."],"roles":["The header labels four distinct fields; the flag column is the primary lookup key.","Type and default are short reference fields; description carries the explanatory prose.","The four body rows each describe one flag, with the short and long forms of require sharing a row."],"keep_whole":["Flag names and aliases where possible, including punctuation and the host-and-port placeholder.","The default address and port, type names, numbers, and inline code identifiers."],"may_wrap":["Descriptions can wrap between words.","The require aliases can occupy separate lines while remaining in the same cell."],"same_scale":["All flag entries share one lookup role, and all descriptions share one explanatory role.","Type and default are both reference fields, but the longer default address needs more width than the type values."],"h_vs_v":"A 360px viewport cannot preserve all unbreakable values and a useful description width at once. Fitting forces some identifiers or values to split and makes rows taller; scrolling can preserve them and reduce vertical fragmentation, at the cost of hiding right-hand fields initially."},"designs":[{"widths":[110,66,80,103],"strategy":"Fit the viewport with a compact lookup column and the remaining space shared among type, default, and description, accepting breaks within long identifiers and the default address."},{"widths":[155,76,135,190],"strategy":"Use moderate horizontal scrolling to keep types and defaults whole while giving descriptions room to wrap and allowing longer flags to span lines."},{"widths":[225,76,135,300],"strategy":"Use a wide scrolling reference layout that keeps every flag and default on one line and gives descriptions generous reading width."}]}
